description: Generate a JSONC snippet for a VTEX IO block ready to paste into blocks.jsonc. Validates props against the block schema.

blockId.description: Unique block identifier appended after #. Example: if blockId is "hero", result is "rich-text#hero". Defaults to the blockName.

blockName.description: VTEX IO block name to generate (e.g. "rich-text", "flex-layout.row", "shelf", "image", "info-card")

props.description: Props to set on the block. Keys must match valid prop names for the block.

name: add-block
